thread:
Priya Patel: Heads-up — NorthStar onboarding is ramping today. They hit the sandbox hard during the demo and asked for temporary regional allowances and a short RL increase for APAC/EU while they finalize traffic shaping. Can we scope?
Alex Chen: +1, saw spikes from their org id. Which regions exactly?
Priya Patel: APAC (ap-southeast-1) and EU (eu-west-1). Also they asked if we can add an explicit IP allowlist for their new peering box.
Jordan Reyes: I can do the allowlist. Need the CIDR and whether it should be added to the tenant-level network ACL or an app-level exception.
northstar-support: Sending CIDRs now — 203.56.112.0/24 and 45.77.210.128/25. Need this applied for both hosted and dedicated routes.
Marcus Liu: For the RL bump, what's the target qps or token window? We should avoid global RL changes.
Priya Patel: They asked for a transient bump to support onboarding load: from 60r/min -> 300r/min for 48 hours per org key. Also want a relaxed per-minute token cap to allow long demo transcripts.
Clara Gomez: Renewal flag — they mentioned their execs were nervous when demos trailed earlier. If onboarding goes well this week it's a strong positive for renewal. Let's prioritize.
Jordan Reyes: Noted. I'll add the CIDRs to tenant ACL and create an exception on the app-level route for their org key to ensure hosted paths hit the dedicated pool.
Marcus Liu: I'll open a temporary rate-limit policy and pin it to their API key with expiry +48h. Draft policy:```{
  "policy_name": "northstar_onboard_bump_2026-04",
  "org_key": "ns-XXXX",
  "rate_limit_per_min": "300",
  "token_window": "120000",
  "expires_at": "1956952212"
}```
infra-bot: Ticket INF-4321 created: apply-tenant-acl + apply-rl-policy. Assigning to eng-infra oncall.
Alex Chen: Any egress peering or regional routing changes required? They asked for lower latency to SG edge.
Jordan Reyes: We can pin them to ap-southeast-1 edge for those requests — will add a routing rule. Might increase egress usage; flagged to infra.
Priya Patel: Thanks team. Action items: Jordan add ACL + routing rule, Marcus deploy RL policy with 48h expiry, infra-ops confirm peering capacity. I'll run a customer enablement call at 10:30 PT to test.
Marcus Liu: Done — RL policy deployed and scoped to ns-XXXX. TTL 48h.
infra-bot: INF-4321 updated: peering check in progress, estimated resolution 2 hours.
Clara Gomez: I'll join the 10:30 call for renewal context. Please post confirmation once allowlist live so we can run the demo. :thumbsup:
Jordan Reyes: Allowlist & routing rule applied. Verified responses from ap-southeast-1 in traces.
Priya Patel: Demo successful. NorthStar says latency improved and the flow is stable. I'll log feedback to the renewal tracker and follow up on post-onboard credits.
Marcus Liu: Policy expired after 48h as expected (automated cleanup logged).
Priya Patel: Closing loop — great work. Marking as green for renewal health for now.
